amendment: run_02 compacts the schedule column vector before retaining it. This corrects spare-capacity asymmetry against the packed-matrix control. All fixtures, thresholds, caps and repetitions are unchanged; run_01 is preserved.
scope: Standalone small Boolean-polynomial matrix construction; no curve inputs, solving, or production solver integration
hypothesis: An exact-support symbolic-product schedule improves charged repeated construction relative to both layout-only reuse and a packed-matrix cache
mathematical_boundary: Over F2, complete normalized support specifies every coefficient. An exact full-system support hit therefore repeats an identical system and matrix, not a distinct coefficient instance.
column_order: ascending monomial bitmask; all four arms use identical compact support
signature: ordered canonical generator supports, n, matrix degree, and active-variable mask; exact equality, no hash-only acceptance
candidate: compile each surviving (generator,multiplier) row into output column indices; replay into a fresh packed matrix only on exact signature match; otherwise use direct construction without replacing the retained schedule

controls.direct: rebuild products, cancellations, compact columns and rows
controls.layout: recompute products and parity; reuse columns only on exact output-support equality
controls.matrix_cache: clone the completed matrix on the same exact signature guard as the schedule

accounting: Charge initial compilation or cache construction once per cold batch, then every lookup, fallback and fresh output. Charge complete output validation separately and include it in total_ns. Fixture generation is common setup outside timing. Rotate arm order by repetition. Retain all samples.
memory: retained structure size from Rust allocation capacities, excluding allocator metadata; separate output payload bytes and fresh-process peak RSS
correctness: byte equality against an independently implemented set-parity matrix constructor for every output, plus exhaustive small-ring evaluation of product parity, stale signatures, degree changes and cap changes
performance_gate: At both batches 16 and 64 and every variable size on held-out repeat fixtures, the 95 percent paired bootstrap lower bound for control total_ns / schedule total_ns must exceed 1.05 against layout and matrix_cache separately; otherwise reject performance promotion
cross_instance_gate: Any claim of cross-instance reuse requires exact schedule hits on changed generator supports; rejection is a valid result
classification: mathematical diagnostic and engineering experiment; no relation-yield, end-to-end IC, asymptotic or rho claim
